name: Santam Ltd
source: CRON 20261014: Santam Limited unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (santam.co.za interim financial statements, condensed consolidated statement of comprehensive income page 11), rand millions. Printed: insurance revenue 27956, insurance service expense (22540), net expense from reinsurance contracts held (2470), result of operating activities 4377, other finance costs (304), net income from associates 61, income tax recovered from structured products 79, profit before tax 4213, total tax expense (1460), profit for the period 2753 of which 2192 attributable to equity holders of the company (non-controlling interest 561), basic earnings per share 2006 cents. Operating Profit (EBIT) is the printed result of operating activities line. Operating profit less other finance costs plus associates plus tax recovered from structured products reproduces the printed profit before tax 4213 exactly, and profit before tax less total tax expense equals the printed profit for the period 2753. Santam is an insurance group and prints no cost of sales, gross profit or single operating expense line, so those rows are left empty rather than mapped from a different basis. | source_url: https://www.santam.co.za/media/hh4mvig3/2026-interim-financial-statements.pdf
